details.description:
This chopper is designed with sharp stainless steel blades and an anti-skid base. Designed for fast and perfect chopping, safe, it comes with a comfortable soft-grip lid, easy pull cord, large handle for easy leverage. Whether you want to prepare an amazing salad with assorted veggies or make a delicious vegetable recipe, this Handy Vegetable Chopper is the ideal kitchen gadget. Control the size by just controlling the number of pulls and an-slip silicone support in base. It comes with three stainless-steel blades that can cut everything from fruits to vegetables with ease. Shatterproof abs food grade plastic & ergonomic conical design to give the best possible chop.
It is easy to clean. Blades, bowl and storage lid are top-rack dishwasher safe. Components come apart for easy cleaning. Powerful & versatile, just put all the ingredients into the container at once and pull a few times to chop everything from onions and garlic to fruits and vegetables in just a few seconds. An-slip silicone support in the base and a reliable prestige warranty.

Prestige Veggie Cutter is a super-functional and quick method to chop up your veggies within seconds. The high-quality 3 blades design offers quick and hassle-free cutting of vegetables, while the stainless steel construct enables long-lasting durability and performance. This manual chopper has a jumbo bowl which is spacious enough to chop up more vegetables at one go. The anti-skid base ensures the chopper offers perfect grip for a class-apart chopping operation.

Prestige Truedge 4 pc Knife Set contains a 2-piece knife, 1 scissor and 1-piece chopping board. It has high-quality stainless steel knives. They are easy to handle giving you the most from your knives. It contains Utility Knife, Paring Knife, Scissors, and Board. It gives you a great cooking experience. It makes cooking quick and efficient. The knives are easy to clean and maintain.
details.usageInstructions: Use these knives for cutting meat, dicing vegetables, disjointing some cuts, slicing herbs, and chopping nuts.

details.description: Prestige Gas Lighter With ABS Body has a bright spark. It is good-looking and pleasing to the eye. Its shape is ergonomically designed to look stylish and easy to handle. If you are looking for a conventional lighter, this stainless steel gas lighter would be the perfect choice for you. It is made from a durable grade stainless steel material and the switch features a finger grip attached below, making the gas lighter easy to hold and use.
